description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Tolarian Academy and another mana-producing land.
